issues.criteria_ref: timeline-three-rounds: 展开卡片以完整提示词代替摘要; attempt-cancelled; attempt-failed
issues.observation: Expanded cancelled (第5次) and failed (第6次) cards keep the header prompt summary and repeat the same prompt below as the full-prompt line, so the prompt appears twice; completed expanded cards replace the summary instead. All required elements are present.
issues.repair_suggestion: For expanded cards without an image, hide the header summary (or skip the full-prompt line when it equals the summary), so the full prompt replaces the summary for every status.

issues.criteria_ref: global: 当前会话在列表中高亮
issues.observation: Current session item shows a double focus ring and a solid red delete button, likely a residual focus or hover state; nothing clipped.
issues.repair_suggestion: Confirm the resting style of the current item does not show a filled red trash button.

issues.observation: Focus on 取消 is not clearly visible in the snapshot (faint border only).
issues.repair_suggestion: Verify activeElement via the probe readback; consider a stronger focus ring.

issues.observation: The library captures are scrolled past the header and tabs, so the 素材库 tab is not in frame; the content still shows the library and a real preview.
issues.repair_suggestion: Optionally also capture the top of the library page, with the tab bar, in future runs.

summary: All 22 real-app screenshots were opened and meet the criteria: no occlusion, clipping, blank or broken images, horizontal scroll, seed word on the image page, or foreign pane content. Real Qwen-Image outputs render in thumbnails, expanded cards and the library preview, and state persists across the restart. One minor: expanded cancelled/failed cards repeat the prompt. Three notes.
